contract.explicit_visual_change: Replace blend-before-filter full-albedo bakes on shipped materials with separate native-size raw-UNORM wound sampling. Baked-pixel equivalence is intentionally not the acceptance contract.
native_invariants: Existing health boundaries, authored armor suppression and paired nonhuman limb order unchanged.

contract.sampling: Keep original base texture identity and its existing source-color/sharpness fetch statement in fragment. Wound sampler has no source_color hint: encoded UNORM interpolation; independent box mip chain and existing sharpness fetch. Blend straight RGB in encoded space using Aw + Ab*(1-Aw), then convert RGB back to the renderer domain.
contract.alpha: Texture alpha uses source-over; world material opacity is applied once by the unchanged world fragment; preview retains its own opacity policy. This preserves remake material coverage, not the original two-pass D3D light/opacity semantics.
contract.unwounded: No-wound branch keeps base fetch; no-wound wisp and healthy/healed captures exact within each final run. Cross-program GL/Forward comparisons against the accepted pre-integration probe are at most one byte step, including healthy/healed.
contract.mip_limit: Independent wound box mips are an explicit remake antialiasing policy. R0/R1 call sites do not establish original wound mip generation; do not claim full native filtering equivalence.

implementation.uploads: One wound image + native-size mip chain per mask/layout/level state, shared across outfits and world/paperdoll materials. No shipped material replacement-albedo job, readback, resize, blend_rect, cache or upload.
implementation.ownership: Native producer shared with a simultaneous legacy custom bake in either request order. Deferred GPU consumers use weak material references, newest-request/base identity guards and job-owned result references surviving LRU eviction. Base replacement invalidates pending wounds.
implementation.selection: Continuously selected override/surface-override copies refresh newly completed wound textures; selecting while pending, worsening while selected and heal/deselect/reselect are covered.

cache.gpu_cached_rgba_mips_bound: At most 4/3 of native byte budget plus final texel per cache entry. Active material/in-flight references are outside cache bounds.
cache.scope: Existing encoded/decoded archive caches and retained SOURCE_IMAGE outfit pixels are not removed or included in this bound.

result.scope: Eight controlled 256px outfit identities per batch, authored unhuma wound bytes; normal asynchronous frame publication. Allocation/work-submission evidence, not device or FPS performance.

mobile_precision_boundary.ordinary_target_failure: production-mobile01: 5 of12 CPU-oracle comparisons fail the unchanged2/255 gate, maximum7/255 in dark channels. Keep as failed ordinary-target numerical control.
mobile_precision_boundary.cause_evidence: Godot Mobile render_forward_mobile.cpp:459-461 uses A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32; scene_forward_mobile.glsl:2355-2382 applies its luminance multiplier and supports fixed 10-bit dither. One stored linear code step after the default 2x luminance decode is up to about6.45/255 near black, consistent with the observed7/255 display steps. The same production shader/math in an HDR16 subviewport passes all strict2/255 oracle comparisons. Float readback is encoded before RGBA8 quantization. No engine or production target change.
mobile_precision_boundary.accepted_scope: Final Mobile numerical oracle uses explicit --precision-oracle only. Before actual material/figure checks the viewport returns to the ordinary production target; all8 actual alpha controls,12 healthy/healed pairs and4 no-wound wisp controls are exact.
